summary: Tested the Rokad 'Kiska?' reference-party feature on backend and frontend. BACKEND (pytest test_rokad_ref_party_v50.py, 11/12 passed): POST with ref SURAJ QA returns ref_party_name 'SURAJ QA'. A ref equal to party_id is stored as null, a bogus ref is stored as null, and an entry with no ref is null. party_id is still required (400). PUT with ref_party_id '' clears the ref, and a later PUT restores it. /api/summary/party/SURAJ returns the entry in memo_rokad and not in rokad, with or without date_from. SURAJ balance stays 1,00,000 in the summary, /api/parties, the trial balance and the outstanding report (checked while a memo entry existed). The INTEREST RECEIVED QA ledger lists the entry in rokad and has no memo_rokad. The one failure: on PUT, a stale ref_party_name sent by the client wins over the new ref_party_id. FRONTEND (Playwright): the ref box shows 'Kiska aaya?' for INTEREST RECEIVED QA, is hidden for SURAJ QA, and shows 'Kiska gaya?' for BANK CHARGES. (expense). Income/expense ledgers are not offered as ref options. Saving a receipt of 25,000 and a payment of 1,000 with ref SURAJ shows '· SURAJ QA ka' in the register. Edit prefills the ref; clearing it and saving removes the tag; adding it back works. SURAJ ledger: memo rows are italic with a MEMO tag. The receipt shows '(₹ 25,000.00)' in the Debit column and the payment shows '(₹ 1,000.00)' in the Credit column. Every balance cell reads ₹ 1,00,000.00 Cr, ledger-memo-total-row is present, and closing is ₹ 1,00,000.00 Cr. Statement view: stmt-memo-row ×N, stmt-memo-total-row present, and the total row reads 'TOTAL (0 ENTRIES)' with 0.00/0.00. The Excel export has a 'Memo (byaj etc.)' column; the INTEREST ledger export does not. INTEREST ledger: ₹ 25,000.00 in the Debit column, closing ₹ 25,000.00 Dr, no memo rows. BUG FOUND: a ref chosen for an income ledger stays in the form after the party is changed to a normal party. The box is hidden, but the ref is still saved, so a normal party's entry becomes a memo on SURAJ.

minor.issue: ref_party_name sent by the client is kept even when it does not match ref_party_id. Example: PUT with ref_party_id=AAKASH and ref_party_name='SURAJ QA' stores the name 'SURAJ QA'. Always take the name from the ref party record: doc['ref_party_name'] = rp['name'].

The backend accepts ref_party_id on any party, not only on income/expense ledgers. It does not check the nature of the party's group, so normal-party entries can create memo rows (this is how the frontend bug below gets saved).

ui_bugs.issue: Steps: pick INTEREST RECEIVED QA, pick ref SURAJ QA, then change the party to a normal party (AAKASH BARGARH.). The box hides, but form.ref_party_id/ref_party_name are kept and sent in the payload (payload = {...form}). The saved entry on AAKASH showed '· SURAJ QA ka' in the register and a MEMO (₹ 7.00) row in SURAJ's ledger. Reproduced in the UI. Fix: clear the ref fields on party pick/change when the new party is not an income/expense ledger, or strip them in save when !isIncomeExpenseLedger. Also add a backend guard.

issues: The 'Memo (byaj etc.)' column has unsigned amounts, and its SUBTOTAL adds receipts and payments together (25,000 + 1,000 + 7 = 26,007). There is no Dr/Cr side. Consider two memo columns (Debit/Credit) or a side column.

design_issues.screen: INTEREST RECEIVED QA ledger / Rokad register T-format
issues: The income ledger row reads only 'Payment Received · CASH IN HAND'. The ref party (SURAJ QA) is not shown on the income ledger; showing it would help. In T-format the party name is cut off ('INTEREST RECEIVE...') next to the small ref tag.

action_items: HIGH: RokadPanna – clear ref_party_id/ref_party_name when the selected party is not an income/expense ledger, either on party change or before building the save payload. Right now the hidden stale ref is saved.
Backend _require_party: drop the ref unless the party's group nature is income/expense (defence in depth).
Backend _require_party: always take ref_party_name from the ref party record, not from the client.
Optional: give the Excel memo column a debit/credit split.
critical_code_review_comments: RokadPanna save sends {...form} with no check of isIncomeExpenseLedger, so ref fields are sent even when the box is hidden.
The ref lookup only checks db.parties, so a ref pointing to a db.accounts ledger is silently dropped. This is fine because refPartyOptions only offers parties.
ACCOUNT CLEAR appears in the ref-party options (it is not filtered like cash/bank). This is minor.
seed_data_creation: Created and then deleted the test rokad entries: 3 UI entries (25,000 INTEREST ref SURAJ, 1,000 BANK CHARGES kharch ref SURAJ, 7 AAKASH stale-ref) and the pytest entries (removed by the fixture). Also deleted the main agent's pre-existing entry a8e00410 (2026-10-30). SURAJ memo_rokad is now empty and his balance is 1,00,000. The QA group and parties are kept.

Memo debit cell testid: ledger-debit-memo-<rokadId>. Retest the stale-ref flow: INTEREST + ref SURAJ, switch party to AAKASH BARGARH., save, and confirm no rokad-ref tag appears.
rca of the issue: Stale ref: the ref box is rendered only when isIncomeExpenseLedger, but form.ref_party_id is never reset when the party changes, and save() posts {...form}. The backend's _require_party keeps any valid ref that is not the party itself, so the hidden ref is saved and party_ledger lists it in memo_rokad for SURAJ.
